Shelf notes · Four places to begin

Books worth carrying around.

Four very different reads for a future session, a long bus ride, or an argument with a friend.

01 · Wonder

The Little Prince

Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

For its quiet questions about friendship, adulthood, and what we fail to notice.
02 · Power

1984

George Orwell

For a conversation about language, truth, surveillance, and who controls memory.
03 · Beauty

The Picture of Dorian Gray

Oscar Wilde

For wit, vanity, influence, and the uneasy cost of living only for appearances.
04 · Memory

The Book Thief

Markus Zusak

For its unusual narrator and its belief in the dangerous, consoling power of words.

About the society

Literature lives
between people.

LitSoc is the Literary Society of BMSIT: a student community for books, cinema, poetry, writing, and the conversations they begin.

We gather to read closely, watch curiously, speak honestly, and make space for new voices across campus.
